name: omnideck-monorepo
description: OmniDeck — Cross-platform Desktop (Windows & Linux, Widevine DRM) and Android media hub for YouTube, Twitch, Spotify, YouTube Music, Reddit, and Audible.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@omnideck/desktop
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:desktop && npm run package:linux --workspace=@omnideck/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run package:win --workspace=@omnideck/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@omnideck/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace=@omnideck/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@omnideck/shared && npm run test --workspace=@omnideck/desktop
